# PeriodicQuantumDot2D

Module: **QuantumDots** · directory: `QuantumDots/src/Programs` · binary: `QuantumDots/src/Programs/PeriodicQuantumDot2D`

```text
usage : 

  -h, --help : display this help
  -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
  -v, --verbose : verbose mode
  -i, --iter-max : maximum number of lanczos iteration (default value = 3000)
  -n, --nbr-eigen : number of eigenvalues (default value = 40)
  -M, --M-cell : number of cells in the x direction (default value = 120)
  --left-x : proportion of left cells omitted in x direction (default value = 0)
  --right-x : proportion of right cells omitted in x direction (default value = 0)
  -N, --N-cell : number of cells in the y direction (default value = 120)
  --left-y : proportion of left cells omitted in y direction (default value = 0)
  --right-y : proportion of right cells omitted in y direction (default value = 0)
  -X, --cell-xsize : cell size in the x direction in Angstrom (default value = 2.9700000000000002)
  -Y, --cell-ysize : cell size in the y direction in Angstrom (default value = 2.9700000000000002)
  --mu-x : electron effective mass in x direction (in vacuum electron mass unit) (default value = 0.16600000000000001)
  --mu-y : electron effective mass in y direction (in vacuum electron mass unit) (default value = 0.16600000000000001)
  --coefficients : name of the file where interaction coeffcients are stored
```
